narrative:
Administrative expenses were EUR 107.8M in FY2025 — staff EUR 60.4M and other general administrative expenses EUR 47.5M — and are budgeted at EUR 118.5M for FY2026. With D&A of EUR 11.2M, the efficiency ratio was 60.1% against an EU average of 55.0%.

The cost base is planned by cost centre × account × entity across ten cost centres. Technology and digital spend is EUR 20M a year, in line with the nearly EUR 20M MoraBanc invested in technology in 2025 (instant payments, Bizum, Apple Pay and online banking).

The Q3 forecast holds admin expenses at EUR 116.1M, an efficiency ratio of 60.7%.

signals.title: Efficiency ratio 60.1% vs EU average 55.0%
signals.excerpt: Staff costs +26% to €60.4M with 584 people, 30% more than three years ago.
